exams.notes: Required for multistate license under Nurse Licensure Compact
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an NCLEX-RN® or NCLEX-PN® examination or recognized predecessor, as applicable.

required.quote: The board shall require advanced practice registered nurses practicing family medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, obstetrics, or gynecology to complete a minimum of one hour of continuing education on nutrition and metabolic health every four years.

available.quote: The board may by endorsement issue a license to practice as a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse to any applicant who is duly licensed as a registered nurse under the laws of another state, territory, or country

requirements.value: Applicant must have passed an examination for licensure, met all other qualifications for licensure as a registered nurse in this state at time of initial licensure, and meet other board criteria.
requirements.quote: Had passed an examination for licensure and met, upon graduation, all other qualifications for licensure as a registered nurse in this state at the time he was initially licensed as a registered nurse.

exists.quote: The Louisiana State Board of Nursing is hereby created within the Louisiana Department of Health

national_certification.quote: certified by a nationally recognized certifying body, such as the American Nurses Credentialing Center

national_association.quote: eight registered nurses appointed by the governor from a list of names submitted by the Louisiana State Nurses Association

regulatory_model.quote: no individual shall practice or offer to practice or perform the duties of a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse unless he possesses a current license issued pursuant to this Part or is exempt from this Part.

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a license to each applicant who applies for licensure as a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse

is_mandatory.quote: no individual shall practice or offer to practice or perform the duties of a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse unless he possesses a current license issued pursuant to this Part

title_protection.quote: Use in connection with his name any designation tending to imply that he is a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse unless duly licensed to practice under the provisions of this Part.

scope_protection.quote: Practice nursing unless duly licensed to do so under the provisions of this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, falsely obtaining, or furnishing any nursing diploma or license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of selling or attempting to sell, falsely obtaining, or furnishing any nursing diploma or license to practice as a registered nurse.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime that reflects inability to practice nursing with due regard for health and safety, or plea of guilty or nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is convicted of a crime or offense which reflects the inability of the nurse to practice nursing with due regard for the health and safety of clients or patients or enters a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a criminal charge regardless of final disposition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfitness or incompetence by reason of negligence, habit, or other cause
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habit, or other cause.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Actual or potential inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety due to use of alcohol or drugs, illness, or mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has demonstrated actual or potential inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to individuals because of use of alcohol or drugs; or has demonstrated inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to individuals because of illness or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting anyone in violation of the nursing practice act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of aiding or abetting anyone in the violation of any provisions of this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prior denial, revocation, suspension, or restriction of a nursing or other health care provider license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license to practice nursing or to practice as another health care provider denied, revoked, suspended, or otherwise restricted.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the nursing practice act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of this Part.

definition_quote.value: Registered nursing means the practice of the scope of nursing which is appropriate to the individual's educational level, knowledge, skills, and abilities, including assessing health status, establishing nursing diagnosis, planning nursing care, implementing nursing care, delegating nursing interventions, and collaborating with other health care providers.
definition_quote.quote: "Registered nursing" means the practice of the scope of nursing which is appropriate to the individual's educational level, knowledge, skills, and abilities

value: assessing health status of individuals or groups
establishing nursing diagnosis and identifying health care needs
establishing goals to meet identified health care needs
implementing nursing care through case finding, health instruction, counseling, providing care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, executing health care regimens as prescribed
delegating nursing interventions to qualified nursing personnel
maintaining nursing care rendered directly or indirectly
teaching theory and practice of nursing
managing and supervising the practice of nursing
collaborating with licensed physicians, dentists, and other health care providers
methods_authorized.quote: Assessing the health status of an individual or group of individuals. (b) Establishing a nursing diagnosis and identifying health care needs, or both. (c) Establishing goals to meet identified health care needs. (d) Planning nursing care measures. (e) Implementing nursing care through such services as case finding, health instruction, health counseling, providing care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing health care regimens as prescribed by licensed physicians, dentists, or other authorized prescribers.

drug_authority.value: APRNs may prescribe legend and certain controlled drugs, therapeutic regimens, medical devices and appliances, and may receive and distribute prepackaged drugs and free samples, in accordance with collaborative practice agreement and board rules. CRNAs may administer anesthetics and ancillary services under direction and supervision of a physician or dentist without a collaborative practice agreement or prescriptive authority.
drug_authority.quote: Advanced practice registered nursing may include certain acts of medical diagnosis, in accordance with R.S. 37:913(8) and (9), or medical prescriptions of therapeutic or corrective nature, prescribing assessment studies, legend and certain controlled drugs, therapeutic regimens, medical devices and appliances, receiving and distributing a therapeutic regimen of prepackaged drugs prepared and labeled by a licensed pharmacist, and free samples supplied by a drug manufacturer

citations.kind: RN anesthetic agents in critical care
medication distribution in public health clinics

license_tiers.quote: no individual shall practice or offer to practice or perform the duties of a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse unless he possesses a current license issued pursuant to this Part

aprn_role_categories.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse shall include, but not be limited to, the following: (a) Certified nurse midwife or "CNM" ... (b) Certified registered nurse anesthetist or "CRNA" ... (c) Clinical nurse specialist or "CNS" ... (d) Nurse practitioner or "NP"

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: under the direction of a licensed physician, optometrist, or dentist acting individually or in his capacity as a member of the medical staff, registered nurse, or physician assistant.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: Except as otherwise provided in R.S. 37:930, acts of medical diagnosis and prescription by an advanced practice registered nurse shall be in accordance with a collaborative practice agreement.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: Except as otherwise provided in R.S. 37:930, acts of medical diagnosis and prescription by an advanced practice registered nurse shall be in accordance with a collaborative practice agreement.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: A permanent register of all persons certified to practice as a medication attendant shall be maintained by the department as part of the nurse aide registry.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: Persons who have successfully completed an approved medication administration course, passed a qualifying certification examination, and been issued a current certification by the department pursuant to this Part shall be permitted to administer certain medications to residents of licensed long-term care facilities and shall be considered direct care staff

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: Delegating nursing interventions to qualified nursing personnel in accordance with criteria established by the board.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is hereby recognized and enacted into law and entered into by this state with all states legally joining therein

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: "Alternative program" means a nondisciplinary monitoring program approved by a licensing board.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: The registered nurse administers anesthetics and ancillary services under the direction and supervision of a physician or dentist who is licensed to practice under the laws of the state of Louisiana.
